Gloo is a disruptive tank who specializes in sustained crowd control, damage transfer, and front?line disruption rather than burst. His kit revolves around applying Sticky stacks to enemies, repeatedly slowing them, reducing their damage against him, and creating multiple Goos that zone and immobilize targets. With strong self?healing, frequent immobilizes, and the ability to repeatedly reset his first skill when interacting with Goos, Gloo becomes harder to kill the longer he stays in the middle of a fight.

Gloo fits best in team compositions that want extended team fights and strong front?to?back control. His ultimate, Grab, Grab, lets him latch onto a priority target, redirect a large portion of the damage he takes to them, and effectively “kidnap” carries by forcing them to move with him. He pairs very well with AoE damage mages and fighters who can capitalize on grouped and slowed enemies. However, he is less effective in fast, pick?oriented comps that end fights quickly or against lineups with high mobility and strong disengage. When drafted into coordinated, team?fight focused comps, Gloo acts as a sticky frontliner who constantly disrupts enemy formations and makes it difficult for them to focus the right targets
Basic Attack Description:
Enemies gain a stack of Sticky each time they're hit by Gloo's skills, decreasing their Movement Speed by 4% for 6s. Stacks up to 5.
Each stack of Sticky on an enemy reduces their damage dealt to Gloo by 4%.
Skill 1 Description:
Gloo reaches out and slams the ground, dealing 80 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemy.
At the final location, a Goo is left behind that explodes after 3s to deal 300 (+12% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage to nearby enemies and immobilize them for 1s. If Gloo touches the Goo, it will explode immediately, reset the skill's cooldown, and heal Gloo for 2.5% of Max HP if the explosion hits an enemy (doubled if it hits an enemy hero).
Skill 2 Description:
Gloo splits into Goos, dealing 100 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area and immobilizing them for 0.5s. While split, Gloo gains 10% Movement Speed and deals 80 (+15% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies it touches, lasting 4s.
If this skill hits a Goo, Gloo will charge over to merge with it, dragging enemies in its path in the same direction for a distance.
Skill 4 Description: Unlocked when any enemy hero has full Sticky stacks. Gloo attaches itself to the target enemy hero for up to 9s, recovering 25% of its Max HP. For the duration, its Basic Attacks are converted to deal 30 (+50% Total Magic Power) (+6% Extra Max HP) Magic Damage, and it transfers 80% of the damage it receives (excluding damage from turrets) to its host. If the target dies while attached, this skill's cooldown is reduced to 5s.

Note: Gord is a high-damage mage who focuses on long-range poke and sustained magic damage through his skill combo. His abilities let him control space in team fights, harass enemies from a safe distance, and punish targets that misposition or walk through choke points. Once he locks someone with his stun, he can quickly follow up with his ultimate channel to melt squishy heroes and force the enemy team to scatter. However, Gord is very immobile and vulnerable to assassins, hard engage, and crowd control that can interrupt his ultimate. He works best when paired with teammates who can peel, provide vision, and set up reliable lockdown so he can safely channel his damage from the backline.
Basic Attack Description: After Gord hits an enemy 4 times with skills within a short period of time, the next skill damage will deal an additional 140 (+60% Total Magic Power) True Damage and slow them by 20% for 1s (the slow effect stacks up to 2 times).
Skill 1 Description: Gord conjures a Mystic Orb that bounces in the target direction and explodes on the first enemy hit, dealing 270 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area, while stunning them and revealing their locations for 1s.
Skill 2 Description: Gord creates an energy field in the target area, dealing 30 (+14% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.25s to enemies within (up to 16 times).
Skill 4 Description:
Gord unleashes an energy beam in the target direction, dealing 110 (+32% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit every 0.2s (up to 16 times).

The direction of the beam can be adjusted using the Joystick.

Note: Granger is a burst-focused marksman who relies on precise skill shots and careful positioning rather than continuous basic attacks. His kit lets him quickly unload high damage in a short window, making him very strong at punishing mispositioned enemies and securing picks before objectives. With proper farm and items, Granger can delete squishy targets from a safe distance, especially when he has vision and frontline protection. However, he is vulnerable when his skills are on cooldown, and he struggles against heavy crowd control, hard engage, and heroes that can dive or outrange him. Granger works best with teammates who can provide reliable crowd control, vision, and peel so he can safely fire his shots and clean up fights.
Basic Attack Description:
Granger's unique Demon Hunting Gun and Cannon are powered by Demonic Energy. Both his weapons have a starting Energy cap of 800. His Gun restores 8% Energy per second while his Cannon restores 2% Energy per second. Each Minion / Creep kill will permanently increase the Energy cap of Granger's Gun and Cannon by 6 / 6, and instantly restore their Energy by 5% / 5%, respectively. Every kill or assist on an enemy hero will permanently increase their Energy cap by 12 and instantly restore 10% Energy.
Every 1% CD Reduction Granger gains is converted into 2 Physical Attack. Demonic Energy cost is not affected by Energy Cost Reductions.
Skill 1 Description:
Granger rapidly fires 6 shot(s) with his Gun, with each shot dealing 60 (+45% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and consuming 70 Gun Energy. The last bullet is guaranteed to Crit. Each bullet deals an additional 35 damage to Creeps and Minions. While firing, Granger's Movement Speed is increased by 10%.

Granger stops firing when he runs out of Energy, or when the skill is cast again. Rhapsody has a brief cooldown and can be cast once his Gun Energy is over 420.
Skill 2 Description:
Granger uses his Demon Hunter agility to dash in the target direction, instantly restoring 15% Energy for his Gun.

Rondo can be cast while channeling Rhapsody. Each time Rhapsody hits an enemy, Rondo's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5s.
Skill 4 Description:
Granger fires his Cannon in the target direction, dealing 150 (+110% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and other targets in the blast radius. Targets hit will be briefly slowed. Granger can roll in the Joystick's direction after each shot.
Death Sonata can be cast while firing Rhapsody. Death Sonata has a brief cooldown and consumes 250 of Granger's Cannon Energy per shot.

Note:
Grock is a tank/fighter who excels at hard engage, front?line control, and punishing enemies that fight near terrain. His kit revolves around charging through walls for extra damage and mobility, creating zone?blocking walls that reshape the battlefield, and using Tectonic Charge to deliver explosive knock?ups when he collides with obstacles. With high base durability, bonus defenses near structures and terrain, and strong early damage, Grock can dominate lane, invade jungle entrances, and force enemies to respect choke points.

Grock fits best in drafts that want fast, decisive engages and strong objective control around tight spaces. He pairs extremely well with AoE mages and follow?up CC heroes who can capitalize when he pins enemies against walls or knocks them up in clustered areas. However, he can struggle in wide?open areas where terrain is scarce or against highly mobile backliners who can kite around his skill ranges. When played with good map awareness and wall usage, Grock becomes a disruptive frontliner who both starts fights on his terms and makes it very difficult for enemies to safely position around turrets and objectives.
Basic Attack Description:
Grock gains a Shield equal to 14% of his Max HP and empowers the next Basic Attack to deal Physical Damage equal to 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of the target's Max HP (capped at 300(+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). This effect has a 18-12s cooldown (decreases with level), which reduces by 200% when near terrain.
Grock gains Control Immunity while casting skills and 30(+6*Hero Level)% extra Physical Defense while the Shield is active
Skill 1 Description: Grock strikes forward with massive force, dealing 240 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Enemies with obstacles behind them are knocked back into the obstacle, launched airborne, and take extra Physical Damage equal to 4 (+2% Total Physical Defense)% of their Max HP (capped at 300(+20*Hero Level) against non-hero units). If there are no obstacles behind, enemies are only knocked back slightly.
Skill 2 Description:
After a brief delay, Grock summons a stone wall in the target area, dealing 100 (+60% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage and knocking enemies towards him.
Use Again: Cancel the wall early.
Skill 4 Description: Grock charges forward, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in his path. Upon hitting terrain, he immediately stops and triggers a massive explosion that knocks nearby enemies airborne for 1s and deals 650 (+300% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. If this skill doesn't hit terrain, 50% of its cooldown is refunded.

Note:
Guinevere is a magic?damage fighter who excels at burst combos and extended airborne crowd control rather than sustained pokes. Her kit revolves around closing the gap with Spatial Migration, knocking enemies into the air, and then chaining Violet Requiem to keep them juggled while dealing massive magic damage in a small area. With Super Magic and Energy Wave providing extra damage, cooldown reduction, and self?sustain, Guinevere can quickly delete squishy targets if she lands her initial engage.

Guinevere works best with lineups that can help her reach priority targets or keep enemies grouped, such as tanks and supports with reliable crowd control or frontliners who can start fights first. When her team provides vision, peel, and follow?up damage, Guinevere can dive deep into the enemy backline, lock down key carries with repeated airborne effects, and instantly swing small skirmishes or full 5v5 fights in her team’s favor.
Basic Attack Description:
Guinevere deals 25% extra damage to airborne enemies and deals (+80% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage with her Basic Attacks.
Guinevere builds Super Magic each time she deals damage. Once fully charged, her next Basic Attack becomes guided, dealing 80 (+100% Total Physical Attack) (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic damage on hit and restoring 80 plus 8% of her lost HP.
Enemies hit by Guinevere's skills or enhanced Basic Attack will be marked for 5s. Those with 3 marks will be knocked airborne when hit by her Violet Requiem.
Skill 1 Description:
Guinevere releases an energy orb in the target direction, dealing 300 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing enemies by 25% for 1.2s.
Successfully hitting an enemy reduces all her skill cooldowns by 1s.
Skill 2 Description:
Guinevere leaps to the target location, dealing 250 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Enemy heroes and Creeps hit will be knocked airborne for 1s and take 125 (+50% Total Magic Power) additional Magic Damage.
Use Again: Guinevere blinks toward the target direction and leaves an illusion behind. If the illusion takes damage by hero, it restores Super Magic for Guinevere and explodes after 1.5s, dealing 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.
Skill 4 Description:
Guinevere creates a force field around her, gaining Control Immunity while attacking nearby enemies 11 times within 2s, dealing 880 (+385% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage in total.
Airborne enemies hit will be knocked airborne again, up to 8 additional times.

Note: Gusion is a magic damage Assassin focused on burst/Magic Damage from fast skill combos rather than basic right?click DPS. His passive, Dagger Specialist, adds runes to his daggers whenever he casts skills, empowering his next Basic Attack to deal extra damage based on the target’s Max HP and restoring HP to himself. With Sword Spike, he throws a dagger to mark an enemy and then instantly blinks behind them, while Shadowblade Slaughter lets him throw and recall multiple daggers to hit and slow several targets. His ultimate, Incandescence, gives him high mobility and resets Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter, enabling double casts and more daggers in a single combo. Overall, Gusion is designed as a high?mobility, high?burst assassin who excels at quickly deleting priority targets but requires precise execution and good positioning to avoid getting caught.
Basic Attack Description: Each skill cast adds a rune to Gusion's dagger (stacks up to 4 times). Each stack enhances Gusion's next Basic Attack to deal additional damage equal to 3% of the target's Max HP and restore 50 (+25% Total Magic Power) HP to himself.
Skill 1 Description:
Gusion throws a dagger in the target direction, dealing 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the first enemy hit and marking them.

Use Again: Gusion moves behind the marked enemy, dealing 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. This skill cannot be interrupted while Gusion is moving behind the marked enemy.
Skill 2 Description:
Gusion throws a volley of daggers in the target direction, each dealing 100 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 6% for 2s (when hit by multiple daggers, the slow effect can stack up to 30%).

Use Again: Gusion recalls the daggers, each dealing 65 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path.
Skill 4 Description:
Gusion dashes to the target location, resetting the cooldowns of Sword Spike and Shadowblade Slaughter. If Shadowblade Slaughter was cast once before the reset, Gusion can throw another five daggers on his next Shadowblade Slaughter cast, and recall a total of ten daggers afterward.

Use Again: Gusion dashes a short distance in the target direction.

Note:
Hanabi is a late?game marksman who excels at team fights and front?to?back damage thanks to her bouncing Basic Attacks and strong anti?crowd?control tools. With Petal Barrage, her attacks can consistently hit multiple targets, shredding grouped enemies and applying on?hit effects across the frontline and backline at the same time. She has no dash and poor mobility, but Equinox’s shield and control immunity allow her to ignore many pick tools and hard CC attempts as long as she times it well, making her surprisingly hard to lock down when properly protected.

Hanabi fits best in comps that can frontline for her and keep enemies within bounce range, such as tanky initiators and strong peel supports. She thrives in drawn?out 5v5 fights around objectives where she can free?hit behind her team, stacking Petal Barrage damage and scaling with items. However, she is vulnerable to burst assassins and heavy dive if her shield is down or her team lacks peel. When drafted with reliable engage plus protection, Hanabi can act as a high?safety DPS anchor who slowly but surely takes over the game once she hits her core items
Basic Attack Description: Hanabi's Basic Attacks and skills will launch Petal Blades after hitting a target, dealing 30% damage, and bouncing up to 4 times to nearby enemies. Bounces from her Basic Attacks inherit her Attack Effects.
Skill 1 Description:
Passive: The secret Ninjutsu of the Scarlet Shadow makes Hanabi immune to control effects when she has a shield from any source.

Active: Hanabi gains a 300 (+40% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s. When the shield is active, Hanabi gains 20% Movement Speed and 25% Attack Speed, and 20% of her damage dealt to enemy heroes will be added to this shield (only adds 10% of the damage dealt to non-hero units). This shield cannot exceed 50% of Hanabi's max HP.
Skill 2 Description: Hanabi fires the energy Kunai in the targeted direction, dealing 350 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and reducing their Movement Speed by 60% for 1s. Enemy units hit will also be marked, allowing Hanabi's next Bounce Damage from Basic Attacks to deal 30 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage on them with no damage decay.
Skill 4 Description: Hanabi throws Higanbana in the targeted direction, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hero hit and immobilizing them for 0.8s. After 1s, Higanbana will bloom at the location of the first hit, dealing 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies. Subsequent hits on the same target decay to 30% damage.

Note: Hanzo is a high-risk, high-reward Physical Assassin who specializes in poke and burst damage by abusing his Demon Ninja form. His passive, Ame no Habakiri, lets him stack Dark Ninjutsu with his basic attacks and skills, enabling Ninjutsu: Demon Feast to instantly consume creeps for sustain or deal heavy burst damage to heroes, jungle objectives, and recover HP while reducing its own cooldown. Ninjutsu: Dark Mist gives him mobility and zoning, creating an area that repeatedly damages and slows enemies while boosting his Movement Speed. His ultimate, Kinjutsu: Pinnacle Ninja, allows Hanzo to enter Hanekage form, leaving his body invincible while the demon form gains high Movement Speed and Attack Speed to dive and assassinate targets. However, if the demon form is killed or mispositioned, Hanzo’s real body becomes vulnerable, so he requires good map awareness, positioning, and resource management to fully capitalize on his poke and burst potential without throwing fights
Basic Attack Description: Damage dealt by Hanzo's Basic Attacks and skills inflicts a stack of Dark Ninjutsu on the target, up to 5 stacks. Ninjutsu: Demon Feast can only be cast on targets with full stacks of Dark Ninjutsu.
Skill 1 Description:
The skill can only be used on targets with max stacks of Dark Ninjutsu. When targeting a creep, Hanzo will immediately devour it and digest it over a period of time to recover 20% HP.
When targeting the Turtle, Lord, or enemy heroes, he deals 600 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, recovers 10% HP, and reduces this skill's cooldown by 60%.
Skill 2 Description:
Hanzo dashes in the target direction, leaving dark mist in front that deals 90 (+45% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area every 0.5s, up to 5 times (this damage counts as Basic Attack damage but cannot Crit).
The dark mist slows enemies in the area by 40% and grants Hanzo 20% Movement Speed.
Skill 4 Description:
Hanzo charges into battle as Hanekage, consuming 17 Energy per second. He gains 2 Energy when a non-hero unit dies nearby and 20 Energy when it's a hero. After consuming all his Energy, Hanzo's body will be slowly drawn to Hanekage's current position.
While in Hanekage form, Hanzo's body is invincible, and Hanekage ignores obstacles and gains 50% Movement Speed (decays over time) and 30% Attack Speed.
After being killed, Hanekage will be immediately drawn to Hanzo's position, during which he recovers 16% HP and cannot be targeted. This effect is also triggered when the skill is cast again. If Hanekage is killed, Hanzo will be slowed by 50% and reveal his location for 6s.

Note:
Harley is a high?mobility burst mage/assassin who specializes in quickly chunking or deleting priority targets and then escaping before the enemy can retaliate. His kit revolves around weaving Poke Trick damage through card volleys and using Deadly Magic to mark an enemy, amplifying the total damage they take before the ring explodes. With Space Escape, he can blink in to start a combo and then safely return to his hat, making him very hard to catch when played around vision and cooldowns.

Harley fits best in drafts that want strong early–mid game pick potential and skirmish control. He pairs well with tanks or supports that can lock enemies in place long enough for his full combo and ring explosion to land, as well as junglers who can follow up on low?HP targets he leaves behind. However, he is vulnerable if he misuses his blink or overextends without a safe return path, and he struggles to kill very tanky targets without item advantage. When played with good map awareness and flank timing, Harley becomes a slippery burst threat who constantly pressures enemy backliners and forces them to respect every fog?of?war angle
Basic Attack Description: Harley's mastery of magic allows his Basic Attacks and skills to reduce the enemy's Magic Defense by 2 and increase his Attack Speed by 5%-10% (scales with level) for 3s on hit. This effect stacks up to 10 times. Harley's Basic Attacks deal 60 (+50% Total Physical Attack) (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage.
Skill 1 Description: Harley throws 3 waves of cards 3 cards per wave. Each card dealing 130 (+25% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies.After the same target is hit 3 times, the damage will decay to 50% on subsequent hits.
Skill 2 Description: Harley blinks in the designated direction, leaving a magic hat at his starting location. His Movement Speed by 60% for 2s. then returns to normal over 4s. Use Again : Return to the hat's location.
Skill 4 Description: Harley casts a magic ring of fire at an enemy hero, dealing 200 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and a 40% slow effect that decays to 15% after 1.5s. The ring will stay around the target, during which Harley can hit the ring to damage the target. The ring will explode after 4s, dealing Magic Damage equal to 200 (+50% Total Magic Power) plus 30% of the damage taken by the target while the ring was active.

Note:
Hayabusa is a high?mobility physical assassin who specializes in picking off isolated targets, outplaying enemies with shadows, and split?pushing side lanes. His kit revolves around stacking Shadow Marks with Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken and Quad Shadow, then using Ougi: Shadow Kill to deliver heavy single?target burst that scales with those marks. With multiple dashes and teleport options through his shadows, Hayabusa can quickly dive in, deal damage, and reposition before the enemy can lock him down.

Hayabusa fits best in drafts that want strong side?lane pressure, backline assassination, and map?wide kill threat rather than pure 5v5 front?to?back fights. He pairs well with heroes that can provide vision, crowd control, or front?line stability so he has time to find flanks and angles onto enemy carries. However, he struggles into heavy point?and?click CC, strong peel, or lineups that group tightly and deny isolated targets. When played with good wave management, jungle timing, and shadow control, Hayabusa becomes a constant side?lane and backline threat who can quietly snowball the game through picks and split?push
Basic Attack Description: Hayabusa's attacks apply a stack of Shadow Mark on hit (up to 4 stacks). Each stack lasts 6s and increases Hayabusa's damage to the enemy by 5%.
Skill 1 Description: Hayabusa throws three returning shurikens in the target direction, each dealing 220 (+75% Extra Physical Attack)Physical Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 35% for 2s. Enemies hit by multiple shurikens take 70% less damage after the first hit, and Creeps take 50% less damage after the first hit. Hayabusa restores 10 energy when hitting non-Minion enemies.Passive: Hayabusa permanently gains 3% Spell Vamp.
Skill 2 Description: Hayabusa dashes in the target direction and releases four phantoms that travel in separate directions. The phantoms will remain at the end of their paths or attach themselves to the first enemy hero hit, dealing 130 (+30% Extra Physical Attack)Physical Damage and slowing them by 40% for 2s. Hayabusa will immediately stop if he hits an enemy hero during the dash.Use Again: Hayabusa teleports to a phantom's location and reduces the cooldown of Ninjutsu: Phantom Shuriken by 1s. If the phantom is attached to an enemy hero, he also deals 130 (+30% Extra Physical Attack)Physical Damage to the enemy.
Skill 4 Description: Hayabusa blends into the shadows and launches 6 single-target attacks on enemies in the area, each dealing 140 (+32% Extra Physical Attack)Physical Damage. The attacks prioritize enemies with Shadow Mark and each will consume a mark to deal 90 (+40% Extra Physical Attack) extra Physical Damage. Shadow Kill does not apply Shadow Mark

Note:
Hilda is a durable fighter/tank who excels at early?game skirmishes, chasing enemies through the jungle, and disrupting the enemy backline with repeated engages. Her passive gives her extra HP and a strong shield when hiding in bushes, letting her win trades, scout aggressively, and pressure invades or ganks without burning too many resources. With reliable gap closing, burst damage, and execute damage on her ultimate, Hilda can quickly punish squishy targets who misstep or try to farm alone.

Hilda fits best in lineups that want to play aggressively from the early game, invade the enemy jungle, and snowball through skirmishes. She pairs well with high?damage junglers and roaming supports who can follow up on her engages and benefit from the vision and pressure she creates in the river and jungle. However, she falls off if the game drags on without a lead, especially into heavy peel or kiting comps that can keep her away from priority targets. When used to dominate the early game and force chaotic fights around bushes and jungle entrances, Hilda becomes a powerful tempo tool that opens space for her carries to scale safely
Basic Attack Description: Hilda regenerates 2% of her max HP per second while in the bush. When entering the bush, she gains a shield equal to 15% of her max HP. After leaving the bush, the shield lasts for 5s. This effect has a 10s cooldown.Hilda's Basic Attack and Skills apply a Wilderness Mark on hit, which lasts up to 4s and stacks up to 6. Each stack reduces the target's Physical Defense and Magic Defense by 4%.
Skill 1 Description: Hilda activates the runic power of her great axe, increasing her Movement Speed by 60% for 3s and enhancing her next Basic Attack to deal 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage and slow the target by 40% for 3s. The attack will also deal 120 (+60% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage to enemies behind the target.
Skill 2 Description: Hilda locks onto an enemy target, each time dealing 220 (+100% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage. Skill can be released 3 times at most. The 2nd attack will deal damage to target's surroundings, and the 3rd attack will knock back the target and surrounding enemies temporarily.
Skill 4 Description: Hilda launches a powerful slash on the target enemy, dealing 600 (+250% Extra Physical Attack)Physical Damage and stunning them for 0.2s. Nearby enemies also take 60% damage. Each stack of Wilderness Mark makes Power of Wildness deal 2.5% of the target's Max HP as extra damage. At max stacks, Power of Wildness deals 20% of the target's Max HP as extra damage.

Note: Hylos is a tank who focuses on soaking damage, providing crowd control, and creating space for his team. With his high HP pool and strong sustain from his skills, he can stand on the front line for a long time and block enemy access to his backline. His point?and?click stun and large area slow from his ultimate make it difficult for enemies to move freely in teamfights, especially around objectives and narrow paths. However, he is vulnerable to heroes and lineups that can shred tanks or ignore his frontline presence by diving past him. Hylos works best with teammates who can follow up on his crowd control, deal consistent damage behind him, and use the movement speed and zoning from his ultimate to take winning fights and secure objectives
Basic Attack Description: Hylos gains 1.5 extra Max HP for every 1 extra Max Mana he possesses. When out of Mana, Hylos can use his HP for skill casts.
Skill 1 Description: Hylos gains 50% Movement Speed and causes his next Basic Attack within 3s to deal 300 (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the target, knocking back and stunning them for 1s.The extra Movement Speed rapidly decays over the duration and vanishes after the next Basic Attack.
Skill 2 Description: Hylos releases the Ring of Punishment, dealing 100 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies per second while slowing them by 4% and reducing their Attack Speed by 7.5% for 2.5s (up to 8 stacks). Each stack also increases the enemy's damage taken from the Ring of Punishment by 5%. The Ring of Punishment consumes 30 Mana per second when it's active.Use Again: Hylos cancels the Ring of Punishment.
Skill 4 Description: Hylos creates a huge pathway in the target direction, reducing enemies' Movement Speed by 75% for 1s. The pathway lasts 6s. When on the pathway, Hylos gains Slow Immunity and recovers 3% of his Max HP per second. Allied heroes moving along the pathway gain 60% extra Movement Speed, while enemy heroes on the pathway will be slowed by 25%.

Note: Irithel is a mobile marksman who can attack while moving, making her strong at kiting and repositioning during fights. Her kit gives her good wave clear, armor reduction, and area damage, allowing her to pressure lanes and contribute consistently in teamfights once she has items. With her ultimate, she can quickly jump in to amplify her damage and hit multiple targets, especially when enemies are grouped or already controlled by her team. However, she is weak in the early game, needs farm and proper positioning, and struggles against heavy crowd control or burst assassins that can catch her before she can kite away. Irithel works best with teammates who can protect her, provide reliable crowd control or frontline, and create safe windows for her to deal continuous damage from mid to late game
Basic Attack Description:
Irithel and Leo's immaculate teamwork allows her to shoot while moving. Each Basic Attack will shoot 2 crossbow bolt(s) (but takes longer to refill) that deal (+55% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage per bolt (inherits a portion of Attack Effects).
Moving will build up Jungle Heart, up to a maximum of 10 units, and cause the next Basic Attack to unleash 1 additional bolt(s).
Skill 1 Description: Irithel launches a volley of arrows on the target area, dealing 330 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies within and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 3s.
Skill 2 Description: Leo lets out a piercing roar, dealing 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 40% for 2s.
Skill 4 Description: Irithel orders Leo to leap in the target direction and empowers her crossbow for 10s. For the duration, she gains 30 Movement Speed and her Basic Attacks shoot enhanced crossbow bolts, dealing 120 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target and nearby units. Jungle Heart also accumulates faster for the duration.

Note: Lxia is a burst-oriented mage who thrives on controlling zones and punishing enemies that step into her range at the wrong time. Her skills let her continuously poke, clear waves quickly, and set up traps that force opponents to respect her positioning around objectives. When she times her combos well, Lxia can delete fragile targets and disrupt the enemy frontline before they fully engage. She is especially strong in tight areas where enemies have limited space to dodge her abilities. However, Lxia is vulnerable to hard engage, assassins that can dive her backline, and heroes with strong mobility or sustain who can survive her initial burst and retaliate. She works best with teammates who can provide vision, crowd control, and peel so she can safely output damage from mid to late game.
Basic Attack Description:
Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Starlium Charge to enemies on hit. When Ixia performs a Basic Attack on an enemy with two stacks of Starlium Charge, the attack will consume the stacks and be replaced with Siphon Starlium, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) (+200 Lifesteal) plus (+10*Hero Level) Physical Damage to the target. Ixia recovers HP equal to the damage dealt by Siphon Starlium (only 20(+150 Lifesteal)% against non-hero units) and reduces the target's Movement Speed by 25% for 1s.
Siphon Starlium can trigger on all enemies in front of Ixia that are within her Basic Attack range, but it cannot Crit.
Ixia's Basic Attacks cannot trigger Lifesteal.
Skill 1 Description:
Ixia fires 2 Starlium-charged energy beams along the ground in the target direction, dealing 75 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a rectangular area. When hitting enemy heroes, Ixia gains 50% Movement Speed for 2s.
Enemies hit by both beams will take double damage.
Skill 2 Description: Ixia unleashes a canister of Starlium energy in the target direction, knocking back nearby enemies, and pulling enemies in range to the center line after a short delay and dealing 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Skill 4 Description: Ixia reassembles her weapon into 6 smaller weapons and enters the Barrage state for 4s. In this state, Ixia's Basic Attacks and skills can hit enemies in the large fan-shaped area in front of her but not outside it. Ixia's Basic Attacks can hit up to 6 enemy units (prioritizes heroes), and Siphon Starlium will fire simultaneously with her normal Basic Attacks.

Note: Jawhead adalah fighter yang dapat mengunci musuh dengan burst damage tinggi, dan dapat melempar unit (baik kawan maupun lawan).
Basic Attack Description: Each time Jawhead deals damage to an enemy hero or a Creep, he inflicts a stack of Mecha Suppression on them for 3s (up to 6 stacks). Each stack of Mecha Suppression increases all damage dealt to the target by 2%.
Skill 1 Description: Jawhead launches up to 12 missiles at random nearby enemies over 5s, each missile dealing 135 (+30% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the enemy hit
Skill 2 Description: Jawhead gains 30% Movement Speed and a 500 (+100% Total Physical Attack) shield for 5s. Use Again: : Jawhead flings the nearest unit (prioritizes heroes) to the target location, dealing 300  (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage  to enemies in the area and stunning them for 0.5s. Can be used on allied heroes and they will not take damage.
Skill 4 Description: Jawhead charges into the target enemy hero, dealing 350 (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage  and briefly stunning them. Enemies around the target are knocked back and dealt the same amount of damage. Jawhead is immune to control effects during the charge.

Note:
Johnson is a hard?engage tank/support who specializes in long?range initiation, pick potential, and disruptive team?fight control. In lane he plays like a standard frontliner with strong peel, AoE damage, and decent durability, but his true power comes from his ultimate, which lets him transform into a car, roam quickly across the map, and crash into enemies to start fights on his own terms. With reliable stun, slow, and a lingering damage zone, Johnson can both catch out isolated targets and force 5v5 engages around objectives.

Johnson fits best in lineups that want explosive, commit?heavy team fights and have strong follow?up damage or AoE control. Pairing him with burst mages or wombo?combo heroes greatly amplifies the value of his ultimate engages. However, he is less effective if his engages are poorly coordinated, if the team lacks damage behind him, or if enemies have good vision and disengage tools. When played with good map awareness and communication, Johnson becomes a global threat who constantly pressures the enemy with the risk of sudden, high?impact collisions.
Basic Attack Description: When Johnson's HP drops below 30%, he gains a 300 (+700% Total Physical Defense) shield for 10s. Cooldown: 100s.
Skill 1 Description: Johnson throws his wrench toward the target location, dealing 120 (+220% Total Physical Defense)Magic Damage to enemies in its path. Enemies around the landing point are stunned for 0.8s.
Skill 2 Description: Johnson raises his shield, continuously dealing 120 (+60% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to enemies in a fan-shaped area in the target direction, reducing their Movement Speed and Magic Defense by 10% (stacks up to 3 times) for 2s.While his shield is raised, Johnson can perform Basic Attacks and cast skills.
Skill 4 Description: Johnson transforms into a car and begins accelerating over time. An allied hero can use Hop In when near Johnson to board the car (only 1 allied hero can ride with Johnson). The car will explode upon hitting an enemy hero or obstacle, dealing 300 (+160% Total Magic Power)-450 (+280% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to nearby enemies, stunning them for 0.5-1s (scales with the car's speed before impact), and creating an electrified zone at the location. The zone continuously deals 60 (+20% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage and slows enemies within. While in car state, tap Brake to stop immediately or hold Nitrous to continuously gain speed for up to 5s. Johnson's location will be revealed to the enemy team for 3s when casting this skill.Passive: Johnson's Physical Defense is increased by 10%.

Note:
Julian is a hybrid assassin/fighter mage who excels at flexible combos, sustained skirmish damage, and sticking to targets with repeated pulls and dashes. His kit revolves around chaining three different skills to unlock enhanced versions, letting him adapt his combo for poke, engage, or burst depending on the situation. With Smith’s Legacy empowering his Basic Attacks after skill casts and providing hybrid lifesteal, Julian can win extended trades and brawls as long as he keeps hitting skills and weaving autos.

Julian fits best in drafts that want a magic?damage bruiser who can both frontline in skirmishes and dive onto priority targets. He pairs well with engage supports and tanks that can provide initial lockdown, making it easier for his enhanced skills to connect and keep enemies in place. However, he is skill?shot and cooldown dependent—missing a key ability or misordering his combo can leave him vulnerable to burst or crowd control. When played with good combo discipline and positioning, Julian becomes a versatile mid?game powerhouse who can flex between assassin, bruiser, and team?fight control roles based on build and draft
Basic Attack Description: After casting two different skills, Julian enhances his third skill. Casting the enhanced skill makes all his skills go on a 9-6s Cooldown (decreases with his level).After casting any skill, his Basic Attacks for the next 2s will deal 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack)(+100% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage and pull the target toward him. Casting another skill extends the duration.Julian gains 15% extra Hybrid Lifesteal for 5s each time he hits an enemy hero with his skills (up to 3 stacks).
Skill 1 Description: Julian hurls a flying scythe in the target direction, dealing 420 (+140% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to enemies along the way and slowing them by 30% for 1s.The scythe disappears upon hitting a non-minion enemy.
Skill 2 Description: Julian summons a flying sword and dashes in the target direction, dealing 400 (+80% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to enemies along the way.
Skill 4 Description: Julian casts chains at the target location, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to enemies hit after a short delay and immobilizing them for 1.2s.

Basic Attack Description: Kadita gains the Blessing of the Ocean every 30s. The Blessing is triggered when she takes damage from enemy heroes and lasts 4s, allowing her to recover 65% of the HP lost within the duration afterward.
Skill 1 Description:
Kadita summons an ocean wave to carry herself in the target direction and back, dealing 250 (+90% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. While inside the wave, she gains Control Immunity and 50% Damage Reduction. This skill can pass through obstacles and terrain.

Use Again: Kadita exits the wave without interrupting the wave's movement.
Skill 2 Description:
After a short delay, Kadita summons an ocean wave to erupt at the target location, dealing 350 (+140% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and knocking them airborne for 1s.

Kadita can cast this skill during Ocean Ode to summon an ocean wave beneath her with a shorter eruption delay.
Skill 4 Description:
Kadita dives into the ground and sends ocean waves in all directions (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), each dealing 270 (+60% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit by multiple waves take increased damage. After a short period, the waves return to Kadita, each dealing 180 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit.

When underground, Kadita becomes untargetable and gains 60% Movement Speed.

Note:
Kagura is a high?skill poke/finisher mage who excels at controlling space, kiting, and setting up burst combos with her umbrella. Her kit revolves around Seimei Umbrella to poke and slow enemies from range, then using Rasho Umbrella Flee to cleanse debuffs, reposition, or dodge key skills. With precise umbrella placement, she can harass safely in lane, zone enemies off objectives, and constantly threaten picks from fog of war.

Kagura fits best in drafts that want strong mid?game skirmish power and team?fight control rather than pure front?to?back damage. She pairs especially well with engage tanks or CC supports who can lock enemies inside her umbrella radius, allowing her to chain slows, knockbacks, and burst to finish off priority targets. However, she is mechanically demanding and very punishing if mispositioned, since misusing her mobility or cleanse leaves her exposed to hard engage and assassins. In the right hands and with good setup, Kagura becomes a slippery control mage who can both open fights with poke and close them out by deleting squishy backliners.
Basic Attack Description: Upon retrieving the Seimei Umbrella, Kagura gains a 450 (+80% Total Magic Power) shield, stuns nearby enemies for 0.5s, and slows them by 60% for 1s. Cooldown: 4.5s.
Skill 1 Description:
Kagura sends the Seimei Umbrella to the target location, dealing 315 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in its path and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s. The Umbrella will automatically return to Kagura when she's too far away.
This skill deals 130% damage to non-hero enemies.
Skill 2 Description: Kagura removes all debuffs on her and leaps in the target direction, while leaving the Seimei Umbrella behind.
Skill 4 Description: Kagura invokes the power of the Seimei Umbrella, dealing 330 (+105% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies, knocking them back, and slowing them by 60% for 0.5s.

Note: Kaja is a utility fighter–support who brings strong pick potential, suppression, and burst damage from mid to close range. With his ultimate and movement tools, he can quickly isolate a priority target, drag them into his team, and help delete them before they can react. Kaja is especially threatening when he has vision and teammates who can instantly follow up on his engage, turning small catches into objective advantages. However, he is vulnerable when his ultimate is on cooldown and he struggles against heavy peel, strong frontlines, or heroes that can cleanse or negate crowd control. Kaja works best with lineups that provide additional burst, lockdown, or fast objective taking so every successful pick he starts immediately converts into towers, turtles, lords, or teamfight wins.
Basic Attack Description:
Kaja achieves Wrath Sanction every 6s. His next Basic Attack will send lightning at enemies, dealing Magic Damage equal to 100 (+100% Total Magic Power) plus 4% of targets' Max HP and paralyzing them. The lightning will jump to enemies nearby as well (up to 3 times).

Increases damage by 200% of targets' Max HP on Minions and Creeps.

Paralyze: Slows enemy heroes and summons while reducing their damage by 2.5% (up to 6 stacks) for 5s.
Skill 1 Description:
Kaja releases a Ringed Electric Blade that quickly expands and contracts, dealing 135 (+70% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies hit on its way out and back and paralyzing them. Enemies hit will also have their positions revealed briefly.
Each time Electric Blade deals damage, Kaja restores 100 HP (decays to 30% after multiple hits).
Skill 2 Description: Kaja dashes in the target direction while leaving 3 Lightning Bombs along the way. The Bombs will explode upon enemy contact, dealing 150 (+35% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to the enemies and paralyzing them.
Skill 4 Description:
Kaja deals 200 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to a designated enemy hero, suppresses and paralyzes them for 1.5s.

During the suppression, Kaja can drag the enemy hero along with him.

Note: Fighter/Support dengan kemampuan kontrol area melalui Water Zone, regenerasi HP, dan crowd control yang kuat berupa knock-up dan slam.
Basic Attack Description: After casting a skill, Kalea creates a Water Zone on the ground. When Kalea casts a skill within this zone, she will absorb the Water Zone to enhance her next three Basic Attacks with different effects:First Basic Attack: Kalea dashes to the target, dealing (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Second Basic Attack: Kalea unleashes a flurry of attacks, dealing 200 (+100% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage and recovering 40 (+10% Total HP) (+60% Total Magic Power) HP for herself and the nearby ally with the lowest HP.Third Basic Attack: Kalea uses her tail to strike the area around her target, dealing 100 (+100% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage and creating a new Water Zone. Enhanced Basic Attacks are not affected by Attack Speed.
Skill 1 Description: Kalea slams her fist into the ground, creating a wave that deals 200 (+5% Total HP)Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slows them by 40% for 1.5s.
Skill 2 Description: Kalea charges forward and body slams the first enemy hero she encounters, knocking them airborne for 0.6s while dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage. If she collides with an obstacle or touches the edge of a Water Zone during her charge, Kalea will leap into the air. Cast the skill again to slam down at a target location, dealing 150 (+60% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage and knocking enemies airborne for 0.6s.
Skill 4 Description: Kalea grabs an enemy hero with her tail and slams them down in the Joystick's direction (drag the Joystick to change landing spot). She gains Control Immunity during this process. Upon landing, deals 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack)Physical Damage to the target and nearby enemies.

Note: Karina’s kit revolves around burst damage, resets, and brief periods of safety. Her passive and basic abilities allow her to quickly mark and execute low?HP targets, while her dashes let her close gaps or reposition after securing a kill. Karina’s skills are designed to punish squishy enemies who misposition, enabling her to dive the backline, delete a priority target, then use cooldown resets to either escape or continue the chase. However, her effectiveness heavily depends on timing and target selection, since she is vulnerable when her skills are on cooldown or when diving into heavy crowd control.
Basic Attack Description:
Karina's third consecutive attack on the same enemy deals extra True Damage equal to 100 plus 5 (+2.5% Total Magic Power)% of their lost HP (up to 2000 True Damage against creeps).

If the target is an enemy hero, the cooldowns of Karina's non-Ultimate skills are reduced by 1.5s.
Skill 1 Description:
Karina enters the Dance of Blades state for 3.5s, during which she gains 45% extra Movement Speed, blocks all incoming Basic Attacks, and reflects 100 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage back to the attacker (the damage reflection effect has a cooldown of 0.4s).

Karina's next Basic Attack within the duration deals 150 (+55% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, slows the target by 45% for 1s, and is guaranteed to Crit. Casting the enhanced Basic Attack or Shadow Assault ends the Dance of Blades state early.
Skill 2 Description: Karina launches a spinning slash, dealing 375 (+125% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.
Skill 4 Description:
Karina dashes to the target enemy hero, dealing them 350 (+160% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, applying a Shadow Mark to them, and leaving a Shadowform behind them. The Shadow Mark and Shadowform both last 5s. If the enemy dies within the duration, the cooldown of this skill is reset.

Use Again: Karina dashes back to the Shadowform's location, dealing 150 (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies along the way.

Note: Karrie is a Physical Marksman with an Attack Reliance of Finisher/Damage, built to shred high?HP targets rather than just poke. Her passive, Lightwheel Mark, makes her Basic Attacks and skills apply stacks to enemies; at 5 stacks, they detonate into a lightwheel that deals Max HP–based True Damage, letting her melt tanks and bruisers very quickly. With Spinning Lightwheel, she can slow and zone enemies in a line, and Phantom Step gives her a short dash plus an extra lightwheel hit for both mobility and DPS weaving. Her ultimate, Speedy Lightwheel, puts her into Dual Wield state, greatly boosting her attack pattern by throwing two lightwheels per Basic Attack and increasing her movement speed, turning her into a late?game finisher who excels at deleting frontliners and closing out fights once enemies are low or locked down by her team.
Basic Attack Description: Karrie's Basic Attacks and skills apply a stack of Lightwheel Mark on hit. Once a target has 5 stacks of Lightwheel Marks, the marks will turn into a lightwheel, dealing True Damage equal to 5 (+1% Extra Physical Attack)% of the target's Max HP to them (only up to 300 damage against Creeps).
Skill 1 Description: Karrie releases a sphere of surging energy in the target direction, dealing 250 (+90% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in its path. The sphere will stop upon hitting an enemy hero or reaching its max travel distance, continuously dealing 150 (+20% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 80% for 1s.
Skill 2 Description:
Karrie dashes in the target direction while throwing a lightwheel at the nearest enemy, dealing 150 (+70% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and applying a stack of Lightwheel Mark on them.

When in Dual Wield state, Karrie throws two lightwheels instead.
Skill 4 Description: Karrie enters Dual Wield state for 10s, during which she gains 20% Movement Speed and throws two lightwheels with each Basic Attack, each dealing 40 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and inheriting a portion of Attack Effects.

Note: Khaleed is a high?sustain fighter who excels in extended trades and small skirmishes, especially from the EXP lane. His empowered basic attacks and skill 2 give strong poke, wave control, and self?healing, allowing him to outlast many melee opponents if he can safely channel. Khaleed’s ultimate provides reliable knock?up and displacement to start fights, catch immobile carries, or punish clumped enemies around objectives. However, he struggles against heavy crowd control and highly mobile marksmen or burst mages that can kite him, interrupt his channel, or burst him before he heals. Khaleed works best with teammates who can follow up his engage, provide additional crowd control, or peel for him while he dives into the enemy backline
Basic Attack Description: Khaleed accumulates Desert Power while moving. After Desert Power is fully charged, he will glide on sand, increasing Movement Speed by 35%, making his next Basic Attack deal 50 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target (cannot Crit), and reducing the target's Movement Speed by 40% for 1.5s.
Skill 1 Description:
Khaleed whirls his scimitar, dealing 200 (+140% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and pulling them toward him. This skill can be used up to 3 time(s) in a row.

This skill deals 50% damage to Minions and Creeps.
Skill 2 Description:
Khaleed protects himself with the power of the quicksand, restoring 60 plus 5% of his lost HP and 10 Desert Power every 0.5s, reducing damage taken by 25% for up to 4s.

While channeling, quicksand appears under his feet, slowing the enemy by 60%.
This skill is a Focused Cast. Any other controls will interrupt this skill.
Skill 4 Description:
Khaleed rides the sandstorm and charges toward a designated location, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and knocking them toward his destination. Khaleed is immune to control effects during this process.

Upon reaching the destination, Khaleed will smash the ground, dealing 450 (+160% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the area and stunning them for 1s, and fully charge his Desert Power.

Note:
Khufra is a hard?engage tank who specializes in shutting down mobile heroes and starting fights with disruptive crowd control. His kit revolves around bouncing in with Tyrant’s Revenge, locking enemies in place with Bouncing Ball that punishes dashes and blinks, and finishing engages with Tyrant’s Rage to slam enemies into walls for massive CC and damage. This combination makes it very hard for assassins and dash?reliant carries to play freely when Khufra is tracking them.

Khufra fits best in drafts that want strong, reliable initiation and anti?dive tools. He pairs extremely well with AoE mages and follow?up DPS that can capitalize on grouped, immobilized targets, especially near walls or in tight jungle chokepoints. However, he relies heavily on good angles and fog?of?war setups—if he whiffs his engage or is kited in open space, his impact drops significantly. When played with proper vision, flank timing, and wall usage, Khufra becomes a central engage tank who can both start fights on his terms and deny enemy assassins from freely entering the backline
Passive Description:
Passive ini mengaktifkan kutukan mantra setiap 12 detik, yang memperkuat basic attack berikutnya dengan jangkauan ekstra, memberikan magic damage sebesar persentase physical attack Khufra ditambah persentase max HP target, serta memperlambat (slow) musuh yang terkena. Selain itu, basic attack yang ditingkatkan juga memulihkan HP Khufra sebesar persentase max HP-nya, dan cooldown passive berkurang setiap kali Khufra memberikan efek crowd control (CC) pada hero musuh melalui skill-skillnya.

Efek ini membuat Khufra lebih tangguh dalam pertarungan, karena ia bisa heal diri sambil memberikan damage dan slow, terutama saat dikombinasikan dengan skill CC-nya untuk mengurangi cooldown passive lebih cepat.
Basic Attack Description:
Khufra activates the Spell Curse left by Esmeralda every 12s, enhancing his next Basic Attack. The enhanced Basic Attack gains extra attack range and deals Magic Damage equal to (+120% Total Physical Attack) plus 6% of the target's Max HP. He also slows the target by 30% for 1.5s and heals 8% of his Max HP on hit.
Each time Khufra applies a control effect to an enemy hero with his skill, the cooldown of Spell Curse is reduced by 4s.
Skill 1 Description: Khufra pulls the bandage on his arms to launch himself in the specified direction, dealing Physical Damage equal to 50 plus 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP to all enemy units on the path. When blinking to the furthest distance or encountering a first enemy hero, Khufra will immediately stop, dealing Physical Damage equal to 50 plus 7 (+1.5% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and then knocking them in the air for up to 1s.
Skill 2 Description:
Khufra uses bandage to wrap himself into a magic bouncing ball, increasing his own Physical & Magic Defense by 30%. Enemies trying to use blink skills to move across Khufra will be knocked airborne.
Each time the magic bouncing ball hits the ground, it will deal Magic Damage equal to 50 plus 3 (+2% Extra Physical Attack)% of his Max HP to enemies nearby and slow them by 80% for 0.2s.
Skill 4 Description: Khufra pushes back all enemy targets around him toward his front (this skill can only be interrupted by Suppression), dealing 300 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing them down for 1.25s. If the enemies are knocked against walls, extra Physical Damage equal to 150% of this skill's damage will be inflicted upon them, and they will be stunned, instead of slowed.

Note: Kimmy is a hybrid marksman–mage who is built around constant poke and sustained damage from long range. Her unique ability to move while attacking lets her kite melee heroes and slowly wear down enemies around objectives or in lane. With the right items, she can quickly shred both squishy targets and frontliners, especially when she is allowed to spam her skill shots without getting dived. However, she is vulnerable to hard engage, crowd control, and assassins that can close the gap and burst her before she can reposition. Kimmy works best with teammates who provide reliable peel, solid frontline protection, and additional crowd control so she can stay alive, maintain high DPS, and control space in teamfights
Basic Attack Description: Kimmy can move and aim in different directions when using her Spray Gun, but cannot lock on to a specific enemy. Kimmy's Spray Gun attack deals 5 (+22% Total Physical Attack)(+27% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage. Hitting enemy heroes/non-hero units restores 6/3 Starlium. At max Starlium, Kimmy's Basic Attacks are enhanced to deal 10 (+27% Total Physical Attack)(+32% Total Magic Power) damage and pierce through targets.Kimmy doesn't stop moving while shooting and no longer benefits from Attack Speed Bonus. Every 1% Attack Speed she gains is converted to 1 Magic Power.
Skill 1 Description: Kimmy uses her jetpack to take flight, removing and becoming immune to Slow Effects. She can pass through terrain and gains 90% Movement Speed for 1s. During the flight, she fires 4 Chemical Bolts at nearby enemies, each dealing 20 (+25% Total Physical Attack)(+30% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage and slowing them by 50% for 0.5s.
Skill 2 Description: Kimmy fires a Starlium Beam in the target direction that immobilizes enemies in its path and deals 300 (+50% Total Physical Attack)(+60% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage for 2s.Gain 20 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.
Skill 4 Description: Kimmy charges and fires a Traction Pulse in a target direction. Upon hitting an enemy or reaching its max range, it explodes to deal 200 (+60% Total Physical Attack)(+72% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to nearby enemies and creates a force field that slows enemies within by 75%. After 1s, the field contracts, pulling all enemy heroes to its center and dealing 20% of their current HP as Magic Damage. Gain 40 Starlium for each enemy hero hit.

Note: Lancelot is a high-mobility Physical Assassin/Fighter who excels at chasing and bursting down priority targets. His damage ramps up through Soul Cutter, which increases his damage each time he dashes, making extended combos especially lethal. Puncture allows him to rapidly reposition and reset its cooldown by marking new enemies, while Thorned Rose provides core burst damage and a brief untargetable window that lets him dodge incoming skills. Phantom Execution grants a powerful finishing strike with full invincibility during the dash, enabling him to dive backlines safely when timed well. Lancelot is very strong at punishing mispositioned squishy heroes, but he relies heavily on precise mechanics, good spacing, and proper timing of his invincibility windows—poorly timed engages or misused dashes can leave him exposed and easily punished
Basic Attack Description: Each time Lancelot charges, his damage is increased by 7.5% for 4s, up to 30%.
Skill 1 Description:
Lancelot charges in the target direction, dealing 150 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way and applying a Sword Mark to the first unmarked enemy hit. The Sword Mark lasts 3s.

If Lancelot successfully applies a Sword Mark to an enemy, the skill's cooldown will be reset.
Skill 2 Description: Lancelot strikes in the target direction 3 times, each time dealing 220 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit (damage is reduced when multiple enemies are hit). He's untargetable during this process. Enemies in the center of the area take all the 3 hits and are slowed by 20% for 0.5s. The slow effect can stack.
Skill 4 Description: After a short delay, Lancelot performs an executioner's strike in the target direction, dealing 350 (+170% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit. He is invincible throughout the process.

Note:
Lapu-Lapu is a bruiser fighter who excels at diving into the middle of team fights, soaking damage, and dealing strong mixed burst and sustained DPS. His kit revolves around switching between Lightblades and Heavy Sword stances, letting him play more mobile and poke?oriented in one form and more hard?hitting and durable in the other. With multiple dashes, shields, and AoE skills in both stances, he can reliably enter fights, disrupt the enemy backline, and survive long enough to cycle his cooldowns.

Lapu-Lapu fits best in drafts that want a flexible frontliner who can both start fights and follow up on engages with heavy AoE damage. He pairs well with crowd?control supports and tanks that can help him reach priority targets or group enemies for his ultimate, making his combo much more impactful. However, he relies on good timing of his stance swaps and ultimate—if he dives without cooldowns or defensive tools ready, he can be bursted down before getting value. When piloted with solid timing, wave control, and flanking angles, Lapu-Lapu becomes a durable skirmisher and team?fight threat who can pressure side lanes and turn clustered fights with big ultimates.
Basic Attack Description: Lapu-Lapu accumulates 10 Bravery Blessing each time he deals damage (halved for damage dealt to non-hero units). When Bravery Blessing is full, Lapu-Lapu's next Basic Attack will make him dash toward the target, dealing (+150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage (cannot Crit) and granting him a shield that absorbs 250 (+65*Hero Level) damage for 2.5s.
Skill 1 Description:
Lapu-Lapu releases two boomerangs in the target direction, each boomerang dealing 140 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies hit on its way out and back.

Enemies hit by both boomerangs take 50% damage from the second hit.
Skill 2 Description: Lapu-Lapu dashes in the target direction, dealing 100 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way.
Skill 4 Description:
Lapu-Lapu leaps to the target location while combining his twin blades into one, dealing 300 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies upon landing and slowing them by 60% for 1s. (This skill cannot be interrupted.)
Lapu-Lapu gains 3 times the Bravery Blessing from this skill and skills in transformed state.
For the next 10s, Lapu-Lapu enters Great Sword stance and gains enhanced skills, 30 extra Physical & Magic Defense, and his Basic Attack damage is increased to 120%.

Note:
Layla is a classic backline marksman who focuses on consistent basic?attack damage and extremely long range rather than mobility or burst. Her kit lets her scale hard with items, extending her attack range and AoE damage over time so she can safely hit both frontline and backline from a distance. With decent waveclear and strong tower damage, Layla becomes a major threat in mid to late game team fights and sieges if she can free?hit without being pressured.

Layla fits best in team compositions that can firmly protect and enable a stationary hyper?carry. She pairs well with tanks and supports that offer peel, crowd control, and front?to?back team?fight structure, allowing her to stand still and output maximum DPS. However, she is very vulnerable to assassins, divers, and hard engage due to her lack of dashes or defensive tools. When drafted with strong peel and good vision control, Layla can act as a reliable damage anchor who shreds enemies and objectives once she reaches her core item spikes.
Basic Attack Description: Layla deals increased damage to enemies the farther they are from her (starting at 100% and increasing to 115% at 6 units away).
Skill 1 Description: Layla fires a Malefic Bomb in the target direction, dealing 200 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the first enemy hit (can Crit). Upon hitting an enemy, Layla's Basic Attacks and Void Projectile gain extra range for 3 seconds, and she gains 60% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2 seconds. The duration of the Movement Speed boost is doubled if an enemy hero is hit.
Skill 2 Description: Layla fires an orb of Malefic Energy at the target enemy that explodes on hit, dealing 170 (+65% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to targets in the area and applying a Magic Mark on them for 3 seconds. When Layla hits an enemy with a Magic Mark, she deals 100 (+35% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to nearby enemies and stuns them for 0.25 seconds.
Skill 4 Description: Layla fires a blast of Malefic Energy in the target direction, dealing 500 (150% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in a line. Passive: The range of Layla's Void Projectile and Basic Attacks is increased by 0.6 units, and her sight range is slightly increased each time this skill is upgraded.

Note:
Leomord is a fighter who excels at mid–late game skirmishes with strong execute potential and flexible positioning between mounted and unmounted forms. His kit revolves around shredding low?HP targets with guaranteed Critical Strikes, using Momentum for shielding and front?loaded damage, and Decimation Assault for gap closing and short?range engage. Once Barbiel is summoned and Leomord enters his Mounted State, his Basic Attacks become AOE and usable while moving, allowing him to stick to multiple enemies and pressure both frontline and backline at the same time.

Leomord works best with lineups that can reliably start fights or group enemies together for him, such as tanks and supports with strong crowd control. Natalia is a stealth assassin who excels at punishing mispositioned backliners, controlling vision, and snowballing off early picks. Natalia dashes in the target direction, dealing 250 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in her path.

Skill 4 Description:
Passive: Natalia gains 15% extra Crit Chance.

Active: Natalia immediately enters Assassin Instinct state. Natalia can store up to 2 charges of her Ultimate and each charge has a recharge time of 30s. Creep kills will reduce the current remaining recharge time by 50% of the full recharge time.

His kit revolves around creating Doppelgangers that inherit a portion of his stats and attack effects, allowing him to quickly shred turrets, creep waves, and isolated targets. He pairs well with supports or tanks that can protect the rest of the team while he split pushes, and with junglers or mages who can quickly secure objectives once the enemy formation is broken.
