Once fully transcended, Xavier’s damage spikes significantly and his spell uptime becomes extremely threatening in mid and late game fights.

Xavier works best in lineups that can reliably front line and provide crowd control so he can free?cast from the backline. Tanks and supports that can hold enemies in place—such as hard engage or lockdown heroes—make it much easier for him to land Mystic Field + Infinite Extension combos and get fast Transcendence stacks. He pairs especially well with comps that want to siege turrets or contest objectives at range, using his poke to chip enemies low before full engages. In the right composition, Xavier functions as a high?impact artillery mage who controls space, punishes clumped teams, and constantly threatens cross?map pickoffs with his ultimate.
Passive Description:
Setiap kali Xavier mengenai musuh dengan skill-nya, skill berikutnya akan mendapatkan peningkatan.

Passive ini memiliki tiga tahap:

Tahap I meningkatkan kecepatan gerak Xavier.

Tahap II memperlebar jangkauan skill.

Tahap III mengurangi cooldown semua skill dan memicu mode Transcendence di mana semua skill menjadi lebih kuat serta memberikan tambahan damage.

Passive ini memungkinkan Xavier untuk semakin kuat dalam bertarung saat melakukan serangkaian serangan skill berturut-turut, membuatnya memiliki damage burst yang besar dan kontrol yang efektif pada musuh
Basic Attack Description: Xavier enhances his subsequent skills each time his skill hits an enemy hero. Stage I: Increases Movement Speed by 50% when subsequent skills hit, decaying over 1.2s. Stage II: Width of subsequent skills will be greatly increased. Stage III: Skill Cooldown reduced by 4s (36s for the Ultimate). At Stage III, Xavier enters the Transcendence state.Transcendence: All of Xavier's skills are enhanced to Stage III state for 5s (this duration is extended by 1s each time Xavier's skill hits an enemy).
Skill 1 Description: Xavier fires a Mystic Bullet that deals 480 (+100% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to enemies it passes through.The Bullet's flying distance increases each time it hits an enemy or the Mystic Barrier (up to 5 times).
Skill 2 Description: Xavier conjures a Mystic Barrier that lasts 5s. Enemies that come into contact with the Barrier will take 220 (+65% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage and be slowed by 50%, while allies will gain 50% extra Movement Speed that decays over 1.2s.When hit by Xavier's other skills, the Barrier expands into a Mystic Field for 3s, dealing 220 (+65% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to enemies within and immobilizing them for 1.2s.
Skill 4 Description: Xavier unleashes a beam of Mystic magic in the target direction, dealing 600 (+180% Total Magic Power)Magic Damage to all enemies along its path.Once cast, he also directly enters the Transcendence state and resets the state's duration.

Note: Sun-shin is a flexible Physical Assassin/Marksman hybrid who excels at finisher and chase playstyles through his dual-weapon and map-impact kit. His passive, Heavenly Vow, lets him automatically switch between longbow and glaive based on distance, gaining Weapon Mastery that enhances his next two Basic Attacks with extra Attack Speed, reduced Crit Damage, and bonus Movement Speed, rewarding good spacing and weapon cycling. Traceless provides a short dash and slash that grants brief control immunity and has its cooldown reduced by Weapon Mastery triggers, enabling aggressive outplays and quick disengages. Blood Floods offers both close-range slash and charged long-range arrow variants, giving him strong poke or burst depending on how long the skill is held. His ultimate, Mountain Shocker, turns him into a global threat: he gains vision over the map, summons a turtle ship for high Movement Speed, then rams and bombards a large area with stuns and slow, allowing him to finish low HP targets, start fights, or punish mispositioned enemies from afar.
Basic Attack Description:
Yi Sun-shin attacks with his longbow or glaive according to his distance from the target.
Weapon Mastery: After each weapon switch, the next two Basic Attacks will gain extra Attack Speed, dealing 70% and 55% Crit Damage respectively, and gain 15% Movement Speed for 1s.
Skill 1 Description:
Yi Sun-shin dashes forward and slashes with his glaive, dealing 150 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and becoming immune to control effects for 0.4s.

Each Weapon Mastery triggered reduces the cooldown of Traceless by 1s.
Skill 2 Description:
Tap: Yi Sun-shin slashes swiftly with his glaive, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Hold: Yi Sun-shin shoots a powerful arrow, dealing 240 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage to the target. The arrow's damage scales with the hold time, up to 200%.
Yi Sun-shin gains Weapon Mastery immediately when this skill is used.
Skill 4 Description:
Yi Sun-shin summons a turtle ship and gains sight of the whole map for 2s. The turtle ship lasts for up to 15s, during which Yi Sun-shin gains 70% burst Movement Speed (decays to 20% over 2s).
When cast again, Yi Sun-shin commands the turtle ship to ram toward the target area, dealing 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and stunning enemy units in the central area for 0.8s. Then Yi Sun-shin commands the naval fleet to launch 3 waves of cannon shots on a larger area, each dealing 160 (+50% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and slowing the enemies by 30%.
Yi Sun-shin gains Weapon Mastery effect immediately when this skill is used.

Note:
Yin is a fighter/assassin hybrid who specializes in isolating and deleting single targets with his Domain. His kit revolves around strong dueling tools in lane and the ability to pull one enemy into a 1v1 arena, where he gains enhanced skills, extra damage, and better control over the fight. With good timing, he can remove a key carry or frontliner from a team fight, kill them inside his Domain, and then return to the normal battlefield with a big advantage.

Yin fits best in drafts that want strong pick potential and front?to?back fights where deleting one target quickly can decide the outcome. He pairs well with engage supports and tanks that can help him reach priority targets or force enemies into bad positions before he casts his ultimate. However, he is vulnerable if he ults the wrong target, fights someone he cannot realistically kill 1v1, or gets outscaled by heavy peel and point?and?click CC. When played with good matchup understanding and target selection, Yin becomes a high?pressure duelist and skirmisher who constantly threatens to remove key enemies from crucial fights.
Basic Attack Description: If there are no allied heroes within 4 units of Yin, his damage is increased to 120% and he gains 8% Spell Vamp.
Skill 1 Description:
Yin gains 60% extra Movement Speed (decays over 3s).
Yin can launch an enhanced Basic Attack that deals 25 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage within the duration. Upon hitting an enemy with the enhanced Basic Attack, Yin will throw another charged punch forward, dealing 360 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies in the path.
Successfully throwing the charged punch reduces the skill's cooldown by 35%.
Skill 2 Description:
Yin dashes forward, leaving a Golden Ring behind while dealing 75 (+35% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies along the way. He gains 30% extra Damage Reduction for 4s if an enemy hero is hit.
After 1s, the Golden Ring will catch up with Yin, dealing 150 (+70% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to enemies it passes through and stunning them for 1s.
Skill 4 Description:
After a short delay, Yin locks onto an enemy hero (cannot lock onto pets or clones) and pulls them into a domain for up to 8s and turns into Lieh. When in the domain, the two cannot be affected by other heroes' skills.
Lieh has stronger skills and 50 extra Physical & Magic Defense that last 8s.
The domain will end early if either of the two is killed. If Lieh successfully kills the enemy, he'll recover 20% of his Max HP, leave the domain with the cooldowns of Frenzy Strike and Instant Blast reset, and continue to fight as Lieh for 8s.
If Yin fails to pull his target into the domain, the skill will enter a 3s cooldown.

Note:
Yu Zhong is a sustain?oriented fighter who excels in extended skirmishes, front?to?back fights, and diving into the enemy backline. His kit revolves around stacking Sha Residue to deal damage based on enemies’ lost HP while restoring his own, letting him stay in combat far longer than most fighters. With Dragon Tail and Soul Grip providing strong AoE damage and slows, plus Furious Dive for gap?closing and knock?ups, Yu Zhong can repeatedly disrupt clustered enemies and soften entire teams over time.

Yu Zhong works best in lineups that want to fight frontally or around tight areas, such as objective pits and choke points. When paired with reliable engage or follow?up crowd control from tanks and supports, he can enter Black Dragon Form to start or counter?engage fights, ignore control effects, and force enemy carries to reposition. In the right composition, Yu Zhong acts as a durable bruiser who soaks damage, constantly regenerates through Sha Residue, and slowly overwhelms teams that cannot kite him or burst him down quickly.
Basic Attack Description: Yu Zhong applies Sha Residue to enemy heroes every time he deals damage to them. Sha Residue erupts upon reaching 5 stacks on a target. Then it begins consuming 1 stack every 0.4s to deal Physical Damage equal to 30 (+20% Extra Physical Attack) plus 2.5% of the target's lost HP to the target. Each stack consumed restores 6% of Yu Zhong's lost HP. When Sha Residue erupts, Yu Zhong also gains 30% Movement Speed for 3s.
Skill 1 Description: Yu Zhong infuses his power into his cloak and turns it into a weapon, which starts to attack nearby enemies after a short delay. The inner area of the cloak deals 220 (+100% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage, whereas the sharpened edge deals 275% damage and applies 2 stacks of Sha Residue.
Skill 2 Description:
Yu Zhong unleashes the Dragon Soul, dealing 150 (+120% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage to all enemies in front and slowing them by 60% for 1s.

Upon hitting an enemy, Yu Zhong's next Basic Attack will be enhanced, dealing 108 (+100% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. Upon hitting multiple enemies, the enhanced Basic Attack will apply multiple stacks of Sha Residue and deal up to 200% damage.
Skill 3 Description:
Yu Zhong leaps towards the designated area with his full strength, dealing 180 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He is able to dash one more time in the movement direction.
After a short delay, enemies within the area of effect will be knocked airborne for 0.6s and take 180 (+90% Extra Physical Attack) additional Physical Damage.
Skill 4 Description:
After channeling for 0.6s, Yu Zhong transforms into his Black Dragon Form. For up to 7s, he cannot use any skills but can move freely and will knock back enemy heroes in his path while dealing 180 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage. He also gains 1000 (+200% Extra Physical Attack) Max HP, becomes immune to control effects, and ignores obstacles in this form.
Upon exiting the Black Dragon Form, Yu Zhong enters Dragonoid Form, gaining increased range on all of his skills for 10s.

Basic Attack Description: When Yve deals damage to enemy heroes with her skills, she gains Galactic Power (cooldown: 0.5s), up to 3 stacks. Each stack provides Yve with a 50(+10*Hero Level) (+20% Total Magic Power) shield for 3s.
Skill 1 Description:
Yve detonates Galactic Energy at the target location, dealing 290 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the area.
Successfully hitting an enemy grants Yve 55% extra Movement Speed (halved if a non-hero enemy is hit) that decreases over 1s.
Skill 2 Description:
Yve summons a Void Crystal at the target location, dealing 220 (+40% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to nearby enemies.

Use Again: Yve commands the Crystal to fire materialized energy in the target direction for 2.7s, dealing 75 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies hit and slowing them by 30%. Enemies hit multiple times are slowed by an extra 6% for each hit after the first hit (up to 60%).
Skill 4 Description:
Yve creates a Starfield that lasts 15s. Within the duration, you can Tap or Swipe the screen to attack up to 20 times.
Tap: Deals 340 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies in the target area.
Swipe: Deals 85 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.45s to enemies in the target area for 2.7s and slows them by 60%.
Enemies leaving or entering the Starfield will be immobilized for 0.8s (only once against the same target).
Yve cannot be displaced while the Starfield is active, and the Starfield will remain even if Yve is controlled (except for Suppression).

Note: Zetian adalah mage dengan kemampuan damage area, crowd control, dan peningkatan spell vamp, serta memiliki pasif yang memberikan shield dan knockback.
Basic Attack Description: Phoenix Crown: When Zetian hits enemy heroes with Phoenix Strike or Phoenix Descent, she gains 1% Spell Vamp for 5s, stacking up to 10 times.Celestial Robe: The power of the Phoenix periodically protects Zetian, knocking back and stunning any enemy hero who dares approach her while dealing 90(+10*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to them. She also gains a 300(+20*Hero Level) (+50% Total Magic Power) Shield that lasts 3s. This effect has a 120s cooldown.
Skill 1 Description: Zetian unleashes a Phoenix Wave in the target direction. If it hits an enemy, she automatically casts another wave, up to 3 times. While casting, Zetian can use other skills.The three Phoenix Waves deal 200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage/200 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage/385 (+120% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage, respectively. The third wave hits a larger area and pulls enemies toward the skill direction (not considered a control effect).This skill only has 65% Spell Vamp efficiency against Minions.
Skill 2 Description: Zetian summons a Phoenix Spirit at the target location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect to enemies in the area. The Phoenix Spirit hovers at the location for 3s, dealing 20 (+10% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage every 0.5s and reducing enemies' Magic Defense by 10% while revealing their surrounding area. While the Phoenix Spirit is active, Zetian can use this skill again to command it to charge toward a designated location, dealing 150 (+45% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applying a brief 50% slow effect upon arrival.
Skill 4 Description: Zetian calls upon her divine mandate and the hearts of her people, granting all allied heroes 40% Movement Speed that gradually decays over 3s, while bringing divine retribution upon all enemy heroes, dealing 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stunning them for 0.8s. Zetian gains vision of all enemy heroes during this time.Zetian can cast other skills while channeling this skill.

Note: Mage pengendali summon (Nightmaric Spawn) yang menjadi sumber damage utama, dilengkapi kemampuan poke, stun, dan Ultimate untuk memperkuat summon.
Basic Attack Description: Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied Nightmaric Spawn on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.
Skill 1 Description: Zhask summons a Nightmaric Spawn that inherits 55% of his Attributes (HP, Hybrid Defense, and Magic Power). Nightmaric Spawn will automatically attack nearby enemies by firing a Death Ray at the target, dealing 55 (+20% extra Attack Speed) (+20% Magic Power) Magic Damage and slowing them by up to 30%. If Zhask is too far away from Nightmaric Spawn, it will disappear.Death Ray is considered as a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.Fusion Enhanced Nightmaric Spawn is increased to 180%, and it can be repositioned.
Skill 2 Description: Zhask fires a penetrating mental missile in the designated direction, dealing 300 (+100% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage. Afterward, Nightmaric Spawn will attack enemies hit by Mind Eater (+80% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and stun them for 0.5s. Fusion Enhanced: Increases the damage dealt by Mind Eater
Skill 3 Description: Zhask releases a swarm of Hive Clones in the targeted direction. The clones will explode and deal 55 (+18% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to enemies on contact, reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s. Hive Clones find no target, they will burrow into the ground and ambush enemies passing by.Fusion Enhanced: Zhask releases several swarms of Hive Clones. Subsequent damage dealt to the same target decays to 20%.
Skill 4 Description: Zhask selects a designated position to summon Nightmaric Spawn and fuses with it. Nightmaric Spawn can inherit 100% of his attributes and get extra of them. His skills are enhanced during the fusion period.Use Again: Zhask immediately gets off Nightmaric Spawn and loses enhancement.

Passive Description:
Every time Zhuxin channels Lantern Flare, she converts the Mana spent into up to 15 Crimson Butterflies to follow her Spirit Lantern. After Zhuxin stops channeling Lantern Flare, the Crimson Butterflies will gradually disappear, each restoring 5% of her Max Mana.
Zhuxin has a naturally high base Max Mana, but it doesn't scale with her level.
Skill 1 Description: Zhuxin deals 150 (+30% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in a fan-shaped area and applies 1 stack(s) of Soul Snare. Zhuxin also slows all enemy heroes hit by 20% and gains 20% of extra Movement Speed herself for 1.5s.
Skill 2 Description:
Hold: Zhuxin can move the Spirit Lantern with the skill button, dealing 33 (+28% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies within range every 0.25s (damage to Minions increased by 28%) and applying Soul Snare to enemy heroes hit, each time consuming 120 Mana. When an enemy hero has 10 stacks of Soul Snare, the Crimson Butterflies will capture them, pulling them airborne for 1s.
Release: Throws all captured enemies to the target location, dealing 300 (+150% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage to all enemies in the area. (If an enemy takes damage multiple times, subsequent damage taken will be reduced by 80%.)
Skill 4 Description: Zhuxin blinks to the target location while gaining a 400 (+100% Total Magic Power) shield. While flying, she creates a field around her for 6s. The field deals 60 (+20% Total Magic Power) Magic Damage and applies 1 stack of Soul Snare to enemies every 1s.

Note: Zilong is a physical fighter–assassin who focuses on fast pickoffs and split push pressure. His kit allows him to quickly dive onto isolated targets, displace them with his spear, and finish them with boosted attack speed and true damage from his ultimate. In the side lane, Zilong can constantly threaten turrets and punish enemies who rotate late or defend alone. However, he is vulnerable to crowd control and burst damage, and he becomes much less effective if he falls behind or dives without proper vision. Zilong works best with teammates who can provide wave control, vision, and distraction in teamfights so he can look for flanks, take down key backline targets, or trade objectives on the map.
Basic Attack Description:
After every 3 Basic Attacks, Zilong triggers Dragon Flurry on the next Basic Attack, hitting the target 3 times. Each hit deals 30 (+40% Total Physical Attack) Basic Attack damage and heals himself for 50 (+20% Total Physical Attack) HP.
If the target's HP is below 50%, all damage dealt by Zilong's skills and Basic Attacks is increased by 30.
Skill 1 Description: Zilong flings the target enemy over his head, dealing 250 (+80% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage.
Skill 2 Description:
Zilong lunges at the target enemy, dealing 250 (+60% Total Physical Attack) Physical Damage and reducing their Physical Defense by 15 for 2s. He then launches a Basic Attack on the same target.

The cooldown of Spear Strike is reset each time Zilong kills an enemy.
Skill 4 Description:
Zilong removes all slow effects on himself and gains 40% Movement Speed, 35% Attack Speed, and Slow Immunity for 7.5s.

For the duration, he can trigger Dragon Flurry after every 2 Basic Attacks (instead of the previous 3).
